name: Grange Hill
description: Children's drama series following the lives of students and teachers at Grange Hill comprehensive school.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: It's the first day at a new school for the members of Form 1 Alpha. Benny is too early, Justin is lonely, Judy is scared, Trisha hates the uniform, but Tucker reckons he's got it all sewn up.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Benny's only ambition is to play in the school football team, but he discovers that talent isn't all you need to qualify.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Judy hasn't found it easy to make friends at Grange Hill, so when she finds herself threatened by the school bullies she is very much on her own.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The swimming pool is the centre of activity in today's episode. Tucker sees a new opportunity to torment Justin, but this time Justin strikes back.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Trisha volunteers to help in the Biology Lab. but discovers this creates problems she hadn't counted on.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Tucker and Benny want to prove their daring by exploring a deserted warehouse during the lunch hour, but what starts out as a bit of fun turns into something much more serious.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Ann has a good chance of being elected to the school council, but she reckons without the rather unorthodox tactics adopted by Micky Doyle, a newcomer to Form 1 Alpha.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: A valuable antique pistol is stolen and suspicion falls on Form 1 Alpha. The headmaster threatens to call in the police and cancel the School Festival unless it is returned.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Benny and Trisha are not normally the best of friends, but they find themselves together in unusual surroundings.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The start of a new term brings new faces, a new headmaster and new problems, especially for Benny who is suspected of stealing.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Benny's friends are convinced that he's been stealing from them and refuse to have him in the football team.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Justin thinks he has found a champion in Andrew, but making friends can be hard work.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Trisha reluctantly agrees to call for the unpunctual Simon on her way to school, but this leads to more complications than she'd bargained for.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: As Penny prepares for her first School Council meeting she discovers that an official position has its problems.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Simon is in trouble with Mr Baxter. By the end of the day he's in much worse trouble, all because of Tucker and the Tremblers.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Simon is in big trouble, but things can't get any worse - can they ?

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Despite a warning from the police about a child molester in the area, Cathy takes a short cut home.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Cathy is disturbed by the sudden arrival of her father, and she falls out with Trisha. All might be well, but for Madelin's interference.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Trisha won't speak to Cathy, so when the teachers go on strike, it is with Madelin that Cathy visits the shopping precinct. There, they are soon both in serious trouble.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: The Students Action Group start picketing sports activities to further their campaign for the abolition of school uniform, but they reckon without Mr Baxter.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Cathy makes it up with Trisha, but they are soon in trouble when Jessica Samuels organises another protest over the school uniform.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: As the opening night of the school play approaches, Andrew seems to be sickening for something.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: After the school play, all is returning to normal at Grange Hill, but Tucker is late. This might mean trouble...

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: A weekend field trip in the country should have been quiet and peaceful, but Doyle and his friends are soon in trouble.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Penny and Susi are lost in the forest and a large-scale search is mounted.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Susi's parents threaten to take her away from Grange Hill if she doesn't do well in the exams.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Exams are over, term is ending quietly until Brookdale issues a challenge to Grange Hill.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: In spite of Mr Sutcliffe's help, the new first-year pupils are managing to settle in, but for Duane the first day ends in trouble.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Duane and Tracy have been close friends for years but when they meet new classmates and discover new interests, they begin to drift apart.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: A day trip into the country nearly ends in disaster when Alan and Andrew wander off by themselves.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: After a stormy election campaign in which punches are exchanged instead of policies, Doyle is elected to the school council.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Miss Peterson ignores Sally's plea to be excused games but later has cause to regret her attitude.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The police still haven't caught the bicycle thieves so Pogo suggests they mount a guard on the sheds and Tracy starts an investigation of her own.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Sudhamani's father wants to take her away from Grange Hill because he thinks it's having a bad influence on her, but Trisha and Cathy persuade him to change his mind.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: A delayed lunch break and some hungry school friends give Pogo an idea for making a quick profit.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Penny is banned from contributing to the school magazine after writing a provocative article exposing Doyle's lack of interest in the council.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Benny has to fight hard for his place in the district team, but Mr Baxter wants him to play for the school team instead.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Benny asks if he can be excused the cross country run to save his energy for tonight's district match. Mr Baxter refuses so Tucker decides to help.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: During the half-term, Tucker and Benny start work for Alan's father and by accident discover that someone is stealing valuable building materials from him.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Susi joins the lunchtime judo class to give herself a break from school work, but runs into trouble with one of the school bullies.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: The first trip to the Outdoor Centre ends abruptly when Cathy and Trisha ignore a warning that some parts of the building are unsafe.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: A dare craze is sweeping Grange Hill but for Antoni it is carried one step too far.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Doyle tries to get his own back on Penny after she has once again complained about his poor performance on the School Council.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A wave of vandalism brings about a hard-line response from the new headmistress.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The introduction of a prefect system to combat vandalism only increases the friction that already exists between the younger and older pupils.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The approach of a compulsory medical check gives rise to some anxious moments for both older and younger pupils.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: 'Stewpot' Stewart falls foul of the dreaded PE teacher, Mr Hicks.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Trisha continues to organise resistance against the Colditz conditions imposed on the school to combat vandalism.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Mrs McClusky threatens to cancel the school dance unless the vandals are caught.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Susi's school magazine article angers Mrs McClusky.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Duane is infatuated with Miss Lexington, and Danny's ill-conceived lottery falls foul of Gripper's dirty tricks.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Trisha gets involved with the school council when a rumour starts that school uniform might be brought back.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: A new questionnaire about school dinners ruffles feathers, and Cathy restarts the School Action Group.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Doyle finds a market for the school's light bulbs, and it's increasingly difficult for Alan to find a place to smoke.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Tommy Watson has left it too late for the trip to France. Or has he?

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Justin is worried by a sudden change for the worse in Andrew's behaviour.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Tucker devises a plan to prove that Alan is seeing Susi.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Cathy's group has a paying gig, and Doyle takes up Judo.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Cathy and her group have to face the consequences of taking an afternoon off to play at the dance.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Gripper forces Pogo to do his homework, but he deliberately does it badly. One smashed-up Common Room later, and Mrs. McClusky is on the warpath!

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: A battle of the sexes is thinly disguised as an end of term sportsday.

videos.title: Christmas Special
videos.overview: At the Christmas disco, Brookdale kids try to steal the takings and the equipment.

videos.title: Arrival
videos.overview: A new term at Grange Hill - and a new class of 11-year-olds try to find their way around. And for one school is as bad as he expected.

videos.title: Settling In
videos.overview: Roland's problems get worse and Gripper makes his life intolerable. But going home to mum isn't the answer.

videos.title: Sex Education
videos.overview: The third year start their sex education class, but are they mature enough to cope with it ?

videos.title: Text Books
videos.overview: The chronic shortage of school text books gives Pogo the chance to fill a need and Gripper the chance to make some money.

videos.title: Instruments
videos.overview: Belinda shows a talent for music, but Annette doesn't like anyone else getting the attention.

videos.title: Sports Trials
videos.overview: Sports trials, and Roland does his best. But in the school hockey match Fay and Belinda come up against tough opposition.

videos.title: Saturday Job
videos.overview: Suzanne is bunking off again. Will the school find out about her Saturday job ?

videos.title: Scruffy McDuffy
videos.overview: Suzanne is in more trouble about her uniform, but Scruffy McGuffy looks just as untidy.

videos.title: Stickers
videos.overview: Jonah's badges seem to be multiplying and Annette has found a source of stickers.

videos.title: Exploration
videos.overview: Annette and Belinda set off on an exploration and get more than they bargained for.

videos.title: Sponsorship
videos.overview: Collecting wrappers to pay for science equipment proves to have its dangers.

videos.title: Zoo
videos.overview: The first years go to the zoo - and Jonah and Zammo just can't keep out of trouble.

videos.title: Girl Gangs
videos.overview: Suzanne is having problems - as some of the older girls encourage her to do things she normally wouldn't consider.

videos.title: Diary
videos.overview: Clare has a crush on a teacher, and she can't keep it to herself.

videos.title: Despair
videos.overview: Roland can't seem to do anything right - and Gripper makes his life a misery.

videos.title: School Revue
videos.overview: The school revue has its first night. Mrs McClusky is not amused, and there's a surprise for Scruffy.

videos.title: Aftermath
videos.overview: Jonah and Zammo are collecting for a present to take to Roland in hospital. And Annette and Fay are determined to see he gets it.

videos.title: Exams
videos.overview: The end of term exams, and Pogo hasn't a chance - unless he does some quick thinking.

videos.title: Return
videos.overview: It's the start of a new year: Pogo is selling pens while Gripper is extracting money from the first years.

videos.title: New Faces
videos.overview: Annette tries to spoil Fay's new friendship while Jonah and Zammo go visiting and get into very deep water.

videos.title: Choices
videos.overview: Gripper has a new target, new boy Randir, and Suzanne's becoming increasingly rebellious.

videos.title: Thuggies
videos.overview: Lunch breaks are being reduced, Stewpot's asked out Claire, and Gripper's racist attacks on Randir are intensifying.

videos.title: On Trial
videos.overview: There is a shorter school day at Grange Hill so Jonah and Zammo decide to fill the gap by going elsewhere. Meanwhile Fay's hockey trials bring her relationship with Annette to breaking point.

videos.title: Field Trip
videos.overview: N2 set off on their field trip - but all does not go according to plan.

videos.title: Love Triangle
videos.overview: Suzanne is on the verge of leaving home, and Gripper's demanding an Oath of Allegience.

videos.title: Weightwatchers
videos.overview: Roland decides that he has heard enough jokes about his weight. Meanwhile Julie is doing some research on the staff.

videos.title: Open Day
videos.overview: Who can create the best project for Open Day?

videos.title: An Inspector Calls
videos.overview: Jonah's suggestion for flexitime gets support from an unexpected source.

videos.title: Paper Chase
videos.overview: Suzanne plans to start a pirate school magazine, but she needs paper, and lots of it. Help comes from an unexpected place.

videos.title: Publication
videos.overview: Racially motivated fighting reaches a critical point, and the unofficial school magazine comes off the press.

videos.title: Backlash
videos.overview: While Gripper is away, how will his henchman Denny 'Igor' Rees cope?

videos.title: Repercussions
videos.overview: Gripper's back from suspension and not at all happy about Claire's magazine article against him. Mr. McGuffy is suspended, and a referendum on flexitime is announced.

videos.title: Outward Bound: Part 1
videos.overview: Fun and games on the Outward Bound course, but Roland spends his time in a more unorthodox way.

videos.title: Outward Bound: Part 2
videos.overview: Mr Baxter turns out to be afraid of heights. Meanwhile, Zammo has a near miss during the canoeing exercises.

videos.title: Sympathy
videos.overview: It is exam time at Grange Hill. Jonah decides that the ballot on flexitime requires some special 'assistance'.

videos.title: Rally
videos.overview: Mrs McClusky's suspension of Scruffy produces a very strong reaction among the Grange Hill students. They decide to take some rather extraordinary measures to express their point of view.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Jonah's left, but his obnoxious cousin is at Grange Hill in his place. Zammo's going out with a Brookdale girl, and it's Miss Gordon's first day.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: It is only the first week of term but already Grange Hill is a hotbed of intrigue and crazes.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Jeremy causes Jackie to fall out with Zammo, Annette wears sunglasses to cover her eye makeup and Jeremy pushes his luck with his fake ticket.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Zammo's conflict with Brookdale's Gluxo intensifies, and Annette plans to enter a glamour competition.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Pogo's chain letter scam comes to its inevitable end, and there's an outbreak of head lice at the school.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: A swimming class ends in tragedy.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Grange Hill tries to come to terms with Jeremy's death.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Grange Hill represents Tanzania at the UN association's conference, but Glenroy's diplomatic skills are lacking finesse.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: At the UN Conference, Glenroy's rant ruins the school's participation; Claire and Stewpot are both stood up; and public school bigot John Eastlake gets his just desserts.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: While doing a practice run for the forthcoming school walk Zammo and Kevin find a newsagent's board that announces a school merger.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: It is the Saturday of the sponsored walk and Roland is sweating a lot on the outcome.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Zammo finally delivers Gluxo Remington 's challenge to Jimmy McClaren - it's to be a fight at the warehouse. Janet discovers the truth about Roland's parents.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Annette's got a new Polaroid camera from her mum, but why are there bruises on her arm?

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Does Diane Cooney's boyfriend Mark really exist? Julie Marchant doesn't think so.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Roland steals Annette's bike to sell for Jimmy McClaren, and Miss Gordon goes to see Annette's mother.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: On an orienteering course, Mandy and Sarah move a control marker for a laugh, and Mr Baxter and Roland get hopelessly lost.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Stewpot freaks out during his O level exam. Meanwhile Pogo can hardly restrain himself at the prospect of the nude model at the art club.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: The end of term disco is an opportunity to reunite Claire and Stewpot, also Zammo and Jackie, providing Gluxo Remington doesn't ruin everything!

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The school merger puts Grange Hill in a state of confusion on the first day of term. Just what sort of pet has Calley brought to school in a cardboard box?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Who is the mysterious 'Mr. S' that Annette has been seeing? Fay, Julie and Diane are determined to find out.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Gonch has found a new source of revenue in a local skip, and Calley tries her hand at palm reading.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Ronnie's Walkman is stolen. When it comes to helping old people, Gonch has better things to do, but Hollo's patience is rewarded.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Stewpot is two-timing Claire, a production of West Side Story is planned, and Zammo starts a part-time job at a chippy.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Stewpot's excuses are becoming increasingly hard for Claire to believe, and Banksie persuades Jackie to go on a date.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Calley discovers disturbing facts about her past.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: There are more thefts occurring and Gonch concocts a new venture that brings together fake dentist appointments and rented videos.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Gonch's video scheme hits new snags and Mr. Bronson is convinced Zammo, Mandy and Sarah are the thieves when he finds them near the staff room.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: There is a new pupil in E1 - Henry the mannequin - and he does nothing but make trouble for Gonch.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Gonch bugs the staff room, and the school musical starts to take shape.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Banskie launches a mission to go back to the derelict Brookdale School building.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Fay and Annette plan a fun foursome, babysitting. They reckon without the boys!

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Banksie's brother has a stock car. N4 plan a joy ride...

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Gonch lands himself in deep water when he discovers Mr Bronson 's swimming habit.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Departure day for the French kids. It's au revoir for some and plain goodbye for others. Roland can't face parting with Fabienne at all.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: A suggestion by Hollo saves the musical after the destruction of the sets and Mr. Bronson is determined to get to the bottom of the business of his lost toupee.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: The end of the school year and rehearsals for the Brighton Rock musical limp towards the big night. Helping hands come from unexpected quarters.

videos.title: Christmas Special
videos.overview: At the Christmas Fair, a surprise awaits Gonch and Hollo in the furniture store, Calley is torn between her foster mother and real mother, and Roland dreams of spending Christmas in Paris.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: On his first day at Grange Hill, Ziggy asserts his authority over Imelda Davis. Ant Jones gets into an accelerated spiral of trouble with Mr. Bronson while Danny Kendall just goes back home.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Danny Kendall breaks a pipe exposing fibreglass, and Imelda takes some. Zammo tries to cheat in the moustache weighing competition - why does he need the money so badly?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Imelda gets revenge against Ziggy by putting fibreglass down his back and a small fire causes the entire lower school to be closed.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The mystery of Mr. Bronson's plaster is solved. Both Georgina and Ronnie have Ant Jones in their sights, but so does Mr. Bronson for quite a different reason!

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Laura and Julia attend Cheryl Webb's party, and Julia has too much to drink. Jackie gives Zammo her £25 savings when she finds he's sold his moped.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Gonch starts up a sandwich selling scheme, Georgina is in trouble with Imelda for seeing Ant Jones and Calley is going to start a fanzine.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Tempers fray as the portacabins fail to arrive. Spending just a few minutes with Georgina causes Ant Jones to get into trouble with both Mr. Bronson and Mr. Baxter.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Imelda is determined to have a slice of the profits from Gonch's toast making business, and Ziggy makes an ill-advised foray into the girls changing room.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Mrs. Reagan asks her daughter and Julia to investigate Louise Webb. Zammo's becoming increasingly desperate for money, and Ziggy's aerial bombardment misses its target.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The temporary classrooms finally arrive. Ziggy's letter from the Duke of Edinburgh Award is spiced up by Gonch.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Robbie and Ziggy are busy collecting chalk ends for the Duke of Edinburgh, while Imelda finds a way to raise money. Ant is in trouble again with Mr Bronson and Georgina tries to cheer him up.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Candidates to edit the fanzine are voted in, and Danny Kendall tries to persuade Ant Jones that an apology to Mr. Bronson would be a good idea.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Robbie takes Ziggy on a quick trip to London, while Laura and Julia plan an all night party.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Julia and Laura's all night party is a disaster, and Roland finds out the truth about Zammo.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Ideas for the school magazine are put forward. Can the school become a smoke-free zone?

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Ant falls foul of Mr Bronson yet again and Mr Baxter isn't pleased with either of them. Eamon McClusky's design wins the competition, but nobody's ever heard of him...

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Fay arranges a date with Mr. King. Ziggy plays a trick on Imelda at the swimming baths, but it doesn't have the result he expected.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Louise and Cheryl Webb seem destined to go into care. Jane plans a revenge on Ziggy for throwing her clothes in the swimming pool.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Zammo's mother learns of her son's heroin addiction when a number of items are stolen. Roland does well in his French Oral exam, and the truth emerges about Miss Partridge.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: The speaking wall seems doomed when spiteful messages about Zammo appear on it. Ziggy and Robbie try to ambush Imelda by using Georgina as bait.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: It's examination time at Grange Hill and that brings special problems for Zammo and Fay. Ant has chosen his options, but Mr Bronson has other ideas.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Zammo convinces Jackie he is free of drugs, but then later his mother's cash card goes missing...

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Ant Jones is still missing. Danny Kendall's logo design looks set to be immortalised in the new school badge, and Banksie becomes very competitive with Mr. Kennedy.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: All problems are put aside for the Fun Run. Steven Banks seems to be the only one taking it seriously, and there's a last chance for Ziggy to get revenge on his nemesis, Imelda.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Imelda comes to school with some hair dye and a 'hit list'. The newly acquired 6th form building leaves something to be desired.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Mr. Griffiths takes Helen and Ziggy to the donkey sanctuary and lets them into a secret.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Calley and Ronnie use their secret language, Vince shows Hollo a secret room, and Mr. Griffiths prepares for 'Operation Harriet'.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Operation Harriet seems to be successful, but the arrival of the donkey has not gone unnoticed. Radio Grange Hill gains support from the staff.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Roland negotiates with Mr. Griffiths for a larger common room, and more and more people are finding out about Harriet.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Imelda reveals the secret of Harriet to Mrs. McClusky, and Zammo gets back together with Jackie.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Ziggy and Robbie cause chaos while fetching a reel of cable, and Danny Kendall's father visits the school. Imelda lets Harriet loose, and she damages two cars.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Vince and Hollo propose that the bottle day money is put towards helping Danny Kendall, and Radio Grange Hill gets a test run.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Fundraising meetings are held. Imelda gets into a fight with Ronnie and Hollo is surprised to learn that Gonch has been dating Ronnie.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Imelda finally takes her stubbornness too far, Gonch returns, and Jackie decides she'll forgo the barge trip and go with Zammo instead.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: It's the day of the barge trip. Who is the shadowy figure lurking in the bushes? Is there enough room on the barge to hold Fred's enormous wardrobe, and ego?

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: More adventures on the Grand Union Canal, and Ant Jones gets sent home.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Interviews are recorded for the radio. Mrs. Reagan isn't pleased to see her daughter riding pillion on Banksie's motorbike.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Can Ziggy conquer his fear of heights to erect the banner? Jackie comes to school with an engagement ring.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Gonch takes Harriet out for donkey rides in the park, and Cleaver wrecks the secret den.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Banksie changes his mind about his work experience after meeting Lucy and Perry. Harriet the donkey falls sick.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Gonch convinces Trevor that the school is haunted. A teacher-student meeting ends abruptly when all of the students' ideas are summarily rejected.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: The 6th form get their exam results, Trevor has a meeting with the 'Grange Hill Ghost' and Ant Jones can't please either his own St Joseph's team or his old Grange Hill friends.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Julia starts spying for her father, and the school handbook continues to be misinterpreted as a protest.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Helen and Georgina bid Harriet farewell, Zammo and Jackie go shopping for wedding outfits, and Fay has an unexpected encounter at the craft fair.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Mrs. McClusky is angry at Mr. Bronson for the rulebook, Danny Kendall's return sparks a new feud with St Joseph, and Trevor finally pushes Mr. Scott too far.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Radio Grange Hill stages a sit-in protest. Jackie and Zammo begin to have second thoughts about their marriage.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Trevor Cleaver gets his comeuppance when he participates in an exorcism of the Grange Hill Ghost.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: After the staff versus pupils cricket match, Zammo and Jackie make a surprise announcement.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Misdirecting the new first formers becomes a fun pastime for Grange Hill. A thief is targeting school property. Julia has gone, and Fred wastes no time making advances towards her best friend Laura.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Justine finds that Tegs has been up to no good, but she's in trouble herself for her fancy blouse. There's a surprise in store for Laura when she gets home.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Calley starts reading the bumps on people's heads, Georgina and Helen give each other dares, and Mrs. Reagan's keep fit class has an unseen audience.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Fiona shows Ronnie the Fun House - a hip-hop club and demonstrates her own rap. Gonch starts a P.E. kit service, and Justine rescues Tegs.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Robbie saves Calley from Mauler's amorous advances, but pays for his intervention. Mr. Robson's crash helmet goes missing, and there's a smile on Tegs' face when Mauler gets accused of taking it.

videos.title: Episode 6

videos.overview: Julie returns to school from her time in Spain. Mrs. Maguire announces that she's pregnant. Poppy brings a precious photo to school, but Wayne trips her up, and it is smashed.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Just who is stalking Joanna? Robyn gets the blame for a mistake in allocating homes for the French Exchange scheme.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The sixth formers are paid to monitor bullying. The French exchange kids arrive, and Arnie takes a fancy to Edith - if only he can summon the courage to ask her to go to the disco....

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Julie tells Robyn about her Spanish romance. At the French disco, there's a disagreement about the music, Robyn dances with Mr. Parrott, and the Year 9 peasants revolt against the high refreshment prices.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: A clear up is done after the disco, Chris invents a fight to cover up his strict parents' limitation on his social life, and Julie is convinced to give a talk on bullying.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Mr. Parrott's late night casino visits are taking their toll on both his finances and his appearance. The Anti-bullying counselling starts and Lauren's first customer is Poppy.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Mr. Parrot's careless comment affects Julie's self-esteem. "Bring Your Daughter to Work Day" takes place: Jodie has a disappointing day. Rehearsals for Grease start, and Mme. Lefevre's daughter Cecile makes an impact.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Robyn's spends the evening at a casino and then spends the night on Mr. Parrott's sofa bed. Chris talks to his parents about his religious doubts, but Anna makes a surprise visit.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Miss Carver's class create an audio book, Robyn can't understand why Mr. Parrot has gone so cold, Christophe makes a sudden departure to Paris and Gabriel lets Cecile sing in the musical.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Christophe handles Miss Carver's detention class badly. Chris plans to escape his baptism by leaving home. He tells Anna he's going on a trip, and she surprises him by appearing at the coach station.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Chris and Anna head up to the Highlands but get lost when they get off the coach. A local woman rescues them, but they aren't the only people from Grange Hill in the area - Miss Carver is spending a holiday there.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Robyn calls at Mr. Parrott's house, but he's in no fit state for a tutorial. The net closes in on Chris and Anna, and they finally arrive at Chris's grandmother.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Mr. Parrott goes missing, and Robyn visits his flat, fearing for his safety. At the same time, his letter of resignation has landed on Mr. Robson's desk.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: The Sixth Formers visit the Hologram Laboratory where Christophe kisses Julie. After writing nothing in the history exam, Josh walks down the corridor and then collapses.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Dudley's caught putting graffiti on the school wall, Denny sells advertising for the Grease production, and when Lucy has a roller blading accident, the unpopular Cecile steps forward to replace her.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: There's a surprise for Robyn as Mr. Parrott returns to school. While the Grease show is performed, Mrs. Maguire's baby is delivered by Dennis and Lucy in the loos.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: It's Human Rights Day: a metal cage occupied to represent a prisoner of conscience. Dudley's hardened steel padlock, supposedly keeping Josh's motorbike safe, makes Kevin rather more securely imprisoned than his mother would like.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Lucy meets her widowed dad's new girlfriend, but it's Dennis who makes an instant rapport with her. Sarah-Jane sees Judi's little brother steal sausages.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Dennis encounters Ray, a former Grange Hill pupil, running a local café. Judi has to cut short her school day to pick up her brothers and Josh encounters the badge from his damaged bike on someone's bag.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Judi's mother has Multiple Sclerosis. After spending time with Lucy, Dennis speeds back to rugby practice. On the way, his motorbike hits a truck, and Dennis is catapulted onto the road.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: In hospital, Dennis has no feeling in his legs. Kevin's friends go round to his house, and enjoy themselves: Kevin agrees to have his hair coloured, but his mother is shocked by the results.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The Double Dare Gang spring some dares: a stink bomb onto Mr. Jones, for which Matt is almost caught, and a custard-based revenge on Alec for his outrageous toilet tax.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Lauren and Carlene dress up for a party, are mistaken for prostitutes by the police, and Lauren is strip searched.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: A party at Lauren's house gets out of control. Dai Jones misreads the signals from Miss Carver when she goes round to his house after a boxing match.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Hockey on skates becomes popular. When Judi's brother is hurt while she puts him to bed, Social Services start poking their noses into her home life.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Dennis's return to school causes headaches for Mr. Robson, Mrs. Holmes authority is undermined by Judi's Social Service helper, and Kelly gets nowhere fast with Arnie.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Can the "Hill Hogs" Skate Hockey team win the day? Only if Arnie can get Kelly back, if Josh bothers to turn up and if he can swallow his pride and let Chris play Forward.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Lauren's dad gets the job he wanted in Barbados. Joanna gets sacked from Ray's café. Tom performs his dare to get Mrs. Holmes suspended - in a manner of speaking!

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Alec gets suspended, blamed for the Double Dare Gang's trick on Mrs. Holmes. Lauren's mother finds out about her daughter's wrongful arrest, and Chris hides Joanna in his bedroom.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Judi shames the body-building Wayne, Kevin and Robert. Lauren's friends wish her good luck as she nears the time of her departure to Barbados.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Mr. Hankin demonstrates custard pies in Science, Dill has a bathroom disaster while babysitting for Mrs. Maguire and Joanna cruelly dashes Chris's hopes.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Rachel and Gerald photograph the staff intent on making satirical masks. Laurie calls a radio phone-in about Chris and Joanna, though not naming them - soon the truth is all round the school.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Mr. Robson persuades Jessica to become editor for the school magazine. Dennis recovers in hospital, but Lucy stays away. Cracker dresses up as Mrs. Holmes for a dare.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Wayne disrupts Rachel's Animal Farm project, Liam dashes Lucy's hopes and Dennis gives a bitter interview for the magazine.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: The school magazine is withdrawn after Gemma's father complains about the male pin-up, but Cracker does a roaring trade in illicit photocopies.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: After Rachel's Animal Hill drama, it's time for the dare to beat all dares... Speedy streaks around the school, and Matt photographs his posterior with a Polaroid camera, fixing the photos to the noticeboards.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: On Caveman Day for the Year Sevens, Ian Hudson takes his role of "hunter" too seriously, while Adam Hawkins is extremely nervous. Gemma has fun at Mr. Urdy's expense.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Adam is found in the woods, but his befriended dog comes back with him, Joanna shoplifts earrings for her mother's present, but her mother has no time for her.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Miss Carver gets Year 8 to look after "flour babies" while Zoe and her friends are determined to find the mystery dog they can hear. Adam gets locked in at night.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Some truths about Adam are revealed. The flour babies are kidnapped for a ransom. Joanna disgraces herself at the karaoke session in Ray's café.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Joanna confesses her alcoholism to her mother. Franco's indoor baseball causes Adam to smash some glass in Max's house, and Ian breaks Max's glasses, blaming Adam.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Lisa uses dirty tactics in the Snakeboard challenge, Adam causes his class to earn a detention, and Joanna comes clean about her problem to the other Sixth Formers.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: New boy Sean helps his friend Alec get close to Judi, but first they have to eliminate Colin from the scene. Adam seeks refuge at Miss Carver's house.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Mr. Brisley's Art show turns into something more popular with Nathan as the D.J. Alec has zero success with Judi, while her interest in Wayne becomes apparent.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Chris and Laurie make up. Sean extracts revenge on Wayne for Alec's failure with Judi, but it's Judi herself who pays the price.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: In the aftermath of Judi's knife attack, Wayne goes on a wild goose chase to find her attacker. Judi learns that the wound will leave a significant scar on her face.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: New roller hockey equipment arrives, but it's far from clear who will get to use it. Chris and Dill's friendship grows into something else, and Judi meets Wayne's unpleasant brother.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Franco battles with the school chef to prove his spaghetti recipe is better. The Double Dare Gang try to solve the mystery of the stolen hockey equipment.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Laurie catches out Dill and Chris, Judi removes her dressing, and Dennis suffers an ordeal in the courtroom to settle his compensation claim.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Arnie punches Chris when he discovers Chris's relationship with Dill. Matt plants drugs on Wayne who is expelled when they fall out of his pocket after a talk on bullying.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Sean replaces Judi's CCTV video and persuades Matt to lie low. Learning of Matt's name allows Wayne to look up his address and soon he and Judi are knocking on Matt's front door.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Cracker and Gemma's mice escape, convincing Mrs. Holmes there is a rodent infestation. Wayne persuades Matt to tell the truth to Mr. Robson, and Sean is brought to justice.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Dennis buys Lucy a horse, but she refuses the gift. Later, he treats his friends to a great night out, but misses the important interview the next day.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: There's a final surprise for Dennis including a reunion with old friends and the coach for the French skiing trip departs.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Amy's lack of uniform causes her problems, and Spencer's soon in trouble. Alec's doing community service, but wants to get back to school: after a fight, his father chucks him out.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Calvin suffers an Asthma attack when Nathan throws his inhaler away. Alec returns to school, but there seems little hope that he can stay.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Max takes up the tuba. Alec and Judi get locked in a storeroom then when Alec's careless match starts a fire, and the only exit is the window, Judi falls to her death.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: When Ray gives Alec some work in the café, Wayne decides to picket the entrance. Max loses the tuba in the canal, can he recover in time for the concert?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Wayne takes heavy handed action against Ray's café. When Gemma learns that her parents want to divorce, and she won't be able to stay with her dad, she packs her bags and leaves.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Gemma's friends protest against her going to boarding school, and Becky makes Kamal look very foolish for claiming he snogged her after a date.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: New boy Ben replaces Franco in the football team, but Franco can't bring himself to tell his dad. Gemma's father arranges for her to go to boarding school, and she spends her last day at Grange Hill.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: At the Inter-School Final Franco gets Max to lock Ben in the changing rooms, but has a change of heart. The Double Dare Gang try to rescue Gemma from her new boarding school.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The Inter-School Football cup doesn't stay long in the trophy case. Amy's reading skills give Miss Carver cause for concern. Kamal and his friends start fixing up his brother's car.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Kamal's mates work to raise the £1000 goal for renovating the car. Amy starts special classes to help with her reading. Ben and Franco become determined to return the football trophy.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Amy runs away from school and makes a friend, and Zoe is determined to stop the confrontation with St. Joseph's.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Zoe steps in to help bring the football trophy back, Amy's new friend puts the fear of God into Spencer, and Colin's date with Becky is spoiled.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Lisa makes plans for Tracey's birthday treat, Darren discovers a rabbit, Becky goes to Colin's house for a meal, and Arnie disobeys his father.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Lisa's treat for Tracy almost goes horribly wrong when Tracey is left alone at the hotel. Becky's father arrives with news that he wants to sell the family home.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Lisa and Matt become friends again, Nathan fails his driving test and Sarah-Jane has become dependent on her pills, walking around in a daze.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: To Mr. Jones's dismay Mrs. Holmes volunteers for the Outward Bound course. Kamal and Colin's trip to Brighton turns into a nightmare.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Colin tries to pressure Kamal into going to the police, and stays away from Becky who assumes he's finished with her. Cracker gets part-time work at the café.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: On the Outward Bound trip, Wayne discovers that Sarah-Jane is becoming addicted to anti-depressants. Colin tells Becky about the accident and heads off into the police station.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: After Colin tells the police about the accident, the police question Kamal, and at school, the other sixth formers learn of the situation.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Kamal gets a heavy fine for his driving offences, but renews his friendship with Colin. Sarah-Jane finally asks for Wayne's help, and Cracker's sandwich scheme is rumbled by the Head.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Ofsted are due to visit the school, Dill has an opportunity to go to New York, and Spencer is witness to his father's racist brutality.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Matt learns that his four friends are now couples, Arnie seems to be holding Dill back from her trip abroad, and Evelyn meets a guy who assumes she's at college.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Someone is taking photographs of Adam at the school gates, Mr. Robson is determined to rally his troops for OFSTED and Spencer pushes Anika who knocks her head.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Matt's blind date with Lisa's cousin isn't what he expected. Spencer is left on his own at home. After Dill leaves for New York, Arnie collapses at the airport.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Colin and Kelly are surprised to find Mr. Hankin moonlighting as a stand-up comedian, and Spencer is still on his own at home.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Wayne and Sarah-Jane decide to find Alec, Colin almost gives the game away about Evelyn's age, and Matt has a disaster meeting with another potential girl friend.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Evelyn and Simon's relationship deepens, a complex arrangement of dating starts among the Double Dare Gang, and Arnie collapses at a night club.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Colin gets the TV presenting job, Wayne gets a lead on Alec's location, Spencer makes amends, and Mr. Robson meets an Ofsted Alien, courtesy of Cracker.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Wayne doggedly searches for Alec, Adam's meeting with his father doesn't go well, and the Double Dare Gang decide that "Spring Heeled Jack" must walk the Earth again!

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Miss Carver is not seen in a good light when Ofsted visit, Anika and Amy agree to help out Spencer's mess, Evelyn worries that she might be pregnant, and Arnie realizes he has epilepsy.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Adam gives vent to his feelings about Miss Carver in front of an Ofsted inspector, Spencer's house is cleaned, and he repays the kindness, and things finally get too much for Mr. Robson.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Wayne finally meets up with Alec, the school inspection comes to an end, and Spencer's mother returns.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Adam's tackle breaks Franco's leg: Ian fights Adam in retaliation, but Adam's father's intervention is unwelcome. There's a shock for Evelyn when Simon starts teaching at Grange Hill.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Colin gives Amy and Anika a tour of the studios. The Double Dare Gang give up their enforced dating. Katy and the boys make a horrific discovery while camping.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Wayne starts a cardboard collection scheme to help the homeless, Arnie seems to be at the end of his tether, and Mr. Robson is shocked to find Adam's dad is his alcohol counsellor.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Arnie, intent on suicide, gets new hope after giving a lift to a hitchhiker. Spencer's little party comes to an abrupt end when his father makes a reappearance.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Some fund raising events take place, and Mr. Hankin camps out with Wayne and Alec. The Double Dare Gang take the cardboard boxes that Max had earmarked from his dad's hotel.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Dirty tactics are used to gain cardboard boxes, but Wayne discovers that the whole campaign is basically unprofitable and Arnie has an epileptic fit in public.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: The staff wear period school costume, Evelyn renews her friendship with Kelly, a new plan for the collected cardboard is hatched and the police call again at the Hargreaves house.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Many loose ends are tied up, as term comes to an end. Linford Christie lights the fund-raising bonfire, the double Dare Gang put on a performance and Mr. Hargreaves turns himself in.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The building work creates havoc - and a fire. Shannon decides that she is a prefect, Danny Hartston makes an enemy of Mr. Hankin, and Spencer's dad gets sent to jail for two years.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Ozzie hatches a plan to get the school keys, using self-elected prefect Shannon who in turn delegates the task to Kathy and Martin. Mr. Hankin takes a dislike to Danny Hartston.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Spider frenzy sweeps school, Clare and Vikki start the lunchtime fitness club and Lisa's mother walks out.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Martin, Maddie and Shona explore the basement. Ozzie steals the building plans and when the builders start demolishing the wrong walls, they strike a water pipe, causing a flood.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Tom asks Leah out, Mr. Hankin gives a lecture against smoking, and a meeting about a black refugee sparks off a racist conflict against Nathan and Briony.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Arnie and Wayne use a ruse to get Claire and Vikki out on a date, Ozzie continues his campaign against Mr. Hankin and Mrs. Holmes is seen with her "toy boy".

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Mr. Hankin becomes increasingly certain that Danny Hartson is behind a hate campaign against him, and Mrs. Holmes reveals that the mystery man is her son, Michael.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Lisa and Shona's mother returns - but it's not a happy reunion, just a flying visit with the new boyfriend. What are Darren's parents hiding in the loft?

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Danny's initialled footprint is found in the fresh concrete, Darren's parents act suspiciously and the staff have a sneaky play at Darren's game console.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Shannon arrives at Lisa's party and says that Danny Hartson dumped her, Miss Fraser makes a new friend, and Darren encounters a strange girl in the middle of the night.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Mr. Hankin accuses Danny of breaking into his home, but then Danny's troubles deepen when Shannon claims she spent the night with him.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Maddie sends a fake email to Kathy, Mr. Abbott gets a surprise birthday treat, and Tom has sex with Leah, but afterwards Leah tells Shannon she didn't want it.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Shannon comes clean about her imaginary affair with Danny. Refugee girl Amelia is smuggled into school to alleviate her boredom, but in the evening, the police come knocking at the door.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: There's a shock for Lisa when her mother reveals she is pregnant by boyfriend Dave, and Mr. Hankin gives a talk on testicular cancer.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Shannon tells Tom that he raped Leah, Tracy and Lisa both have their sights set on the talent competition, and when hidden refugee Amelia decides to do a midnight flit, Darren goes with her.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Matt has worries about cancer, Max gets publicity for his protest against company logos on sports strips, and Lisa and Tracy's dispute over Tom flares up into a fight.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Shona behaves badly, Kathy discovers that Martin has Asbergers, Amy and Anika find where Darren and Amelia have been hiding, and Mr. Hankin tenders his resignation.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: When Danny and Ozzie come to blows in the boiler room, Mr. Hankin overhears both sides, but as he enters, the ceiling caves in trapping them all.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Amelia is abducted, Kathy and Martin find evidence of foul play on the part of Mr. Forbes, and things look bad for Danny, Ozzie and Mr. Hankin, trapped in the old boiler room.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Mr. Forbes and Ozzie are arrested, Lisa and Tracey are reconciled, Kelly makes her point, and Wayne's band perform at the talent show, but Ray pays the price for shopping the racist thugs.

videos.overview: Anika wins the web site editor competition while Mr. Robson recovers in hospital. When Maddie gets Shona drunk, Lisa's dad decides the girls should live with their mum.

videos.overview: Amy starts to search for her father, work on the website begins, lunchtime step aerobics start, Lisa lives in fear after her attack, and Maddie is left on her own.

videos.overview: Amy secretly writes a letter to her long lost father and her mother gives her worrying news. Vikki breaks off with Danny when she learns he's not going to Uni.

videos.overview: Amy stays with Anika while her mother is in hospital, Kathy and Josh learn of Maddie's full name, and Nathan has been keeping a secret from Briony.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Briony learns about Nathan's other girlfriend, Maddie is ridiculed, and Cracker is impressed by Ozzie's new night club.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The "No means No" article is pulled from the website, Calvin and Darren's Deostini card selling days are over and Amy learns that her mother has cancer.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Mrs. Holmes becomes increasingly confused by matters at school and home, Danny and Vikki are reunited, and Cracker has decided to leave school to work in the new night club.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Wheelchair-bound Ray visits Lisa, Mr. Deverill picks on Ian, Leah owns up to the website incident, Ozzy ruins Danny and Vikki's celebration and Maddie falls into bad company.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Leah and Shannon fight and receive a Saturday detention from Mr. Deverill. Miss Fraser reveals her engagement to her pupils, to the horror of her fiancée, Michael Barton.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: A Saturday detention allows Maddie, Leah, Shannon, Martin and Ian to reflect on life, "Breakfast Club" style. Amy meets Chaz at a record fair, but afterwards her mother collapses.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Amy gets some tragic news from her mother, Maddie's party goes badly, and Mr. Robson shocks his staff by announcing he is going to resign.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Mr. Deverill loses his temper and strikes Ian Hudson, Ozzy worms his way into Vikki's affections, and Tom reveals his part time work as a male model.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: The staff attend Miss Fraser's barbecue, Lisa watches Tom on his modelling assignment, and Amy's mother loses her battle with cancer.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Ben and Max learn of Mr. Deverill's previous existence - as Mr. Wilcox. Ozzy wins the bet with Chris, Leah leaves school, and Tom becomes a local celebrity after his modelling photos are published.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Maddie stands up to her tormentors, Chris shows Ozzy the counterfeit money he's laundering, and Ian and Ben get the proof they need about Mr. Deverill.

videos.overview: Mr. Deverill is exposed as a violent fraud while Mr. Robson and Miss Carver hold their wedding reception at school, but the fire he unwittingly starts has devastating results.

videos.overview: Annie takes the blame for a missing costume and Class 7d's lesson in pancake making leads to a messy food fight.

videos.overview: When Mr. Wainwright strikes Annie, Baz is determined that his father will get back on his medication, Abel gets literally plastered, and Tranter is found unconscious outside school.

videos.overview: The latest Underpants Dare involves the Head's bow-tie wearing skeleton, Amy falls out with Anika, and Tranter gets a visit in hospital.

videos.overview: Amy panics at her examination, Baz uses a psychological ploy to win Maddie back, and Abel employs a Trojan Horse approach to get the Sacred Undies.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Annie goes to school in a bad mood, forbidden to see her father. Nick goes to Taylor's house to tell him what he witnessed, but Taylor simply doesn't care about his situation - he's just given up. Miss Dyson knows from the swipe card records who ruined Emma's art project - Annie. Annie goes home after lunch, and although her father is pleased to see her, she is told she can't stay, because Social Services will blame him for her absence from school. Baz sees some camcorder footage that Martin has taken and spots Annie walking out the gates. He heads home too, and the old argument ensues - that of Mr. Wainwright not taking his pills. Shannon and Hudson seem to be getting close again, but he is shocked that she is considering to simply work in her grandmother's shop after school ends. Nick tells Mrs Bassinger about Mr. Green's attack, admits to trying to take an exam paper from the office, and is told that he might be barred from taking any further exams. Annie returns, and Miss Dyson lies in wait, but is sympathetic to Annie's woes: Annie must fix up Emma's damaged art project. After school, Baz and Annie's dad is waiting. In the car, Baz tries to persuade his father that he must take his pills.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Taylor is asked by Mrs. Bassinger for his side of events, but he is uncooperative, given up on the idea of staying at school. Karen tells him something that hits home though - she wants him to stay. She also tells him it's unfair that Mr. Green should lose his job - and career, over one mistake, especially as Taylor provoked the teacher into violence. He reconsiders and tells Mrs. Bassinger ungrammatically "no-one hit no-one". Annie's dad visits school, having received a message from her. He tries to tell her that the pills he has to take take away his personality - she finally convinces him that he must take them daily, and that she wants to come back to live with him. Emma, Annie, and Tanya get together and make a pact to be friends again. Mr. Malachay offers Hudson a football training job for the summer holidays - Shannon is shocked to learn that there will be no more opportunities for them to see each other. Mr Green leaves Mrs. Bassinger's office, and on the way sees Taylor. Realizing what Taylor must have done, he thanks him as he passes by.
